title: Crispy Fennel Stir Fry
description: A simple Thai-inspired dish featuring crispy fennel and a crunchy fried element. This recipe can be served as a side or as part of a larger meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the fennel bulb and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the fried shallots, ginger, galangal, and chili pepper to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan and crack the fried egg into the other side.
Scramble the egg until cooked through, then mix it with the vegetables.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
